brands.name: 1Password
brands.summary: The premium consumer password manager, expanded into an enterprise identity platform (Unified Access) in 2026. Known for app polish, the two-secret security model (master password + Secret Key), Watchtower breach monitoring, and family-friendly sharing.
brands.pricing_summary: Individual $3.99/mo (≈$47.88/yr, $2.99 first-year promo); Families $5.99/mo for up to 5 members ($4.49 first-year promo); 14-day trial; no free tier. Verified 2026-09-06 on official pages. Business is quote-led.
brands.affiliate_note: Runs a public affiliate program (third-party listings: ~$2/signup + 25% of first payment). Disclosed wherever used.

brands.name: Bitwarden
brands.jurisdiction: United States (EU region available for business)
brands.summary: The open-source value benchmark: unlimited free tier, $19.80/yr Premium, self-hosting, and transparent per-user business pricing. The recommendation competitors are measured against.
brands.pricing_summary: Free (unlimited passwords/devices); Premium $1.65/mo ($19.80/yr); Families $3.99/mo for 6 premium accounts; Teams $4/user/mo; Enterprise $6/user/mo. All verified 2026-09-06 on the official pricing page. Premium rose from $10/yr in January 2026 (reported).
weaknesses: Sharing concepts add a learning curve
brands.affiliate_note: No public consumer affiliate program found as of 2026-09-06 — our value pick cannot pay for its recommendation.

brands.name: NordPass
brands.summary: The budget-polish play from Nord Security: fast, friendly apps, XChaCha20 encryption, and aggressive term-based promotions. Best value requires multi-year commitments.
brands.pricing_summary: Free tier limited to one device; Premium ≈$1.3–2/mo across terms (2026 range — promotional pricing moves; verify at checkout); Family ≈$2.3–3/mo for 6 users; Business ≈$3.59/user/mo (reported). Term sensitivity is the pricing story.
strengths: Cheapest polished paid tier on long terms
brands.affiliate_note: Affiliate program on Impact (third-party listings: ~30%/sale). Disclosed wherever used.

brands.name: Proton
brands.summary: The privacy-first suite: Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Calendar — and Pass, the open-source password manager with the most capable free tier after Bitwarden's. Swiss jurisdiction is the strategic differentiator.
brands.pricing_summary: Proton Pass Free: unlimited logins/devices, 10 aliases (verified). Pass Plus / Pass Family / Proton Unlimited: priced dynamically at official checkout (we omit unverified figures by policy). 30-day money-back guarantee on paid plans (verified).
weaknesses: Youngest password product in our set
brands.affiliate_note: Referral/affiliate arrangements vary by region; nothing verified applicable to us as of 2026-09-06 — links treated as plain links.
